thread: marco_design: Quick design huddle We need a tiny cookbook for the sidebar regroup rollout: microcopy for breadcrumbs, shortcut conflicts (non-latin keyboards), and what the cluster landing should surface. Thoughts? :chef: lia_pm: +1. customers want deterministic permalinks. Also asked: will sharing a URL show the old or new breadcrumb path? We should surface canonical path in the share dialog. nina_frontend: we can canonicalize on share and in the document.title. For breadcrumbs, prefer: Workspace > ClusterName > Resource > Tab. That keeps context clear. I'll prototype a compact breadcrumb with overflow ellipsis and full tooltip on hover. oliver_router: routing note: reserve the following prefixes to avoid slug collisions: `deployments`, `models`, `observability`, `admin`. We'll reject resource slugs that match these during onboarding. Alternative is prefixing clusters (`/cluster/deployments`) but that's noisy. sam_a11y: accessibility concerns: keyboard shortcuts that use single letters (g+d) can collide with international keymaps. Suggest using chorded shortcuts that include `mod` like `mod+k` then `d`, or two-key sequences that are locale-aware. Also announce breadcrumb changes via polite live region when navigation happens. tess_research: ran 10 quick tests: users preferred landing pages that show a search box + quick actions. For Deployments cluster landing, show: create deployment CTA, recent deployments list, and a handy 'How it maps to infra' hint. Also users liked explicit labels over terse verbs. Use 'Deployments' not 'Deploy'. marco_design: microcopy proposal for migration banner: "We reorganized the sidebar to group related pages. Find Deployments under 'Deployments'." alt (concise): "Sidebar updated: Find Deployments in the new 'Deployments' section." Which tone? lia_pm: go with the first one — explanatory. Add a small 'Show me' CTA that triggers a 3-step guided highlight tour. nina_frontend: UI note: when cluster is collapsed, breadcrumbs should still render cluster as a chip. Example snippet: ``` Workspace › Deployments › webhook-2026 ``` Chip should be focusable and have aria-haspopup=false. oliver_router: analytics: log both originalPath and canonicalPath once per session (hashed). Keep raw path for 14 days. We'll add header `X-Canonical-Path` for internal tracing. infra_bot: created ticket RDW-5120 and subtask RDW-5120a for reserved prefix enforcement. sam_a11y: microcopy for screen readers: breadcrumb container `aria-label=\"Breadcrumb navigation: Deployments in Workspace Alpha\"`. Live region: `aria-live=\"polite\"` message: "Navigated to Deployments in Workspace Alpha". Also ensure tooltips are accessible with `aria-describedby`. tess_research: one more: non-Latin labels can overflow. solution: allow localized short label + `title` with full label, and expand cluster landing title to show full localized string. Also test right-to-left flows. marco_design: decisions: 1) canonical breadcrumb pattern 2) show canonical URL in share dialog 3) reserved prefixes and server-side validation 4) migration banner with "Show me" tour 5) accessibility live-region announcements 6) prefer `mod`+chord shortcuts to reduce collisions. Nina/Tess/Sam: please prototype and validate. Infra_bot: RDW-5120 tracks work. Thanks all :sparkles:
